items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: he was all over me, we were very good friends

ctx.x: Allen. Now, George Wein, a very interesting thing, had not hired me that year for the Newport Jazz Festival. I did 14 Newport Jazz Festivals, 14 years. I was in four riots in those years, and now he had not hired me for the Newport Festival this particular year, but I did the Steve Allen Show and he saw it, and he called me that night as soon as I came off the show -- it was live -- and he said I want you to come over to Newport tomorrow and do the show and I laughed and I thought, oh, dear, I have to be on a…

Then I started to go to Europe. I got -- let's see, George Wein gave a party -- George Wein had now moved into New York and in his apartment he gave a party for Gerald Lascelles, the Queen's cousin, and he invited me to the party and I met Gerald Lascelles, and he was all over me, we were very good friends and he said, 'Oh, I have been following your records, ever since I was a young man,' and he said, 'We are going to have a big jazz festival -- now, this was about 16 years ago, we're going to have a big jazz…
